name: Mitla
detailed_description:
Embark on an epic adventure in MITLA, a challenging 2D platformer inspired by the legends and Mesoamerican mythology of the Oaxaca Valley, Mexico. Take control of a small frog, the reincarnation of a tragic prince, as you navigate a labyrinth filled with deadly traps and ancient secrets.

On this journey, you will discover a world rich in cultural symbolism and face extreme challenges that will test your skills. Each jump, every trap overcome, and every corner explored will bring you closer to the truth behind this moving tale of forbidden love and redemption.

Challenging Platforms: Master precise controls and overcome deadly traps designed to test your skill and patience.
Immersive Narrative: A captivating story full of mystery, tragedy, and the cultural richness of Mesoamerican legends.
Unique Artistic Design: A visual style inspired by pre-Hispanic iconography and art, combined with beautiful vectorized graphics.
Exploration of a Mythical World: Uncover hidden passages and solve puzzles as you unravel the secrets of Mitla’s labyrinth.
Authentic Cultural Inspiration: Elements based on the legends of the Oaxaca Valley, offering an experience deeply rooted in Mesoamerican tradition.

MITLA is more than a video game: it’s a gateway to the world of ancient legends, designed to challenge you while immersing you in the magic and mystery of Mesoamerican culture. Are you ready to face the gods and uncover the secrets of the labyrinth?
